verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an llms.txt served with HTTP 200 at doc.babylonjs.com. A runtime probe confirms both doc.babylonjs.com and www.babylonjs.com serve llms.txt files. Many doc entries show it as a structured index of setup, scene management, meshes, physics, tooling and integrations that an agent can be pointed at directly. However, the docs pages themselves are client-rendered Next.js with no .md mirrors, which limits agent-friendly deep reading beyond the index. Missing for 10: markdown mirrors or other agent-oriented page formats, evidence of an llms-full.txt or comparable full-content export, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the llms.txt effectively.
